title: Chapter 280 Challenging The Monster Ranking
content:
Chapter 280 Challenging The Monster Ranking

On the other hand, the boy is the same.

But he obviously had a lower ability than Dao Qing. At this moment, his chest was extremely uncomfortable and he didn't even want to say anything.

And in the distance, a figure suddenly appeared at the end of his sight.

Everyone immediately looked up.

I saw a man wearing a red robe slowly walking towards here from the bottom of the mountain.

Three balls of different colors of flames were suspended around them and were constantly burning.

Every step he takes, a burning footprint will be left on the ground.

And it is precisely because of the arrival of the man in red that the temperature of the scene rises sharply.

"No."

"A little bit like, not sure, look at it."

"Damn it, it's him!"

"The 27th place in the monster list, Yan Emperor Ye Yan!"

Yan Emperor!

The terrifying monster on the list of demons is the eldest disciple of Huoyun Peak of the Tiandi Academy.

The God of Vulcan in the hearts of countless students in the academy.

At this moment, as the figure of the man in red shirt grew closer and closer in the distance, everyone became more and more excited.

Teng!

Finally, Ye Yan walked through the last step and stood in front of the gate of Tiandi Academy.

Ye Yan's face was cold. Ye Yan didn't even look at Dao Qing and the boy who looked embarrassed on both sides, but said lightly: "Don't block the way."

Immediately, Ye Yan walked into the academy.

Everyone automatically made way and watched Ye Yan slowly walk into the academy.

It was not until Ye Yan could not see that everyone slowly came back to their senses.

"Damn it, it's so hot!"

For a moment, everyone scattered.

But the name Ye Yan undoubtedly rang out from the academy again.

The monster on the evil list is back.

And outside the academy.

Dao Qing and the others looked at each other, both of whom saw the unwillingness in each other's eyes.

The difference between them and the existence on the list of monsters seems to be very far.

And at this time, the old man in yellow robe suddenly appeared beside the young man.

"Teacher, Master."

The boy stood up with difficulty.

Looking at the boy in front of him, the old man in yellow robe said indifferently: "How do you feel?"

Hearing this, the boy smiled bitterly, "I'm short-sighted."

At this moment, the boy's eyes were gone, and replaced by a touch of tenacity.

The evil list is right, sooner or later, He Yi's name will appear on it.

Afterwards, He Yi and the old man in yellow robe left Tiandi Academy, not knowing where they went.

Dao Qing went to the academy gate again to heal his wounds calmly.

But Dao Qing also attached great importance to the so-called evil list.

It seems that the list of monsters is the same as the rumored ones, and it is indeed so terrifying.

There are thirty nouns on the evil list.

And those who are ranked at the end of Ye Yan are already so terrifying, so the top few are worth it.

"Big news, big news!"

"Senior Brother Huoyunfeng, Ye Yan is back!"

"Ye Yan?! Ye Yan on the monster list!"

"nonsense!"

This news just came to the inner courtyard, which caused a huge sensation.

In the square, everyone who was following the martial arts list also became restless and stood up and left.

That's a legend on the monster list.

I haven't seen it in the academy for many years.

I don’t know where these people have experienced it for so many years.

"Ye Yan, Brother Qin, do you want to go and have a look?"

Xiao Luo looked at the people leaving one after another, then came to Qin Feng and smiled.

Hearing this, Qin Feng shook his head slightly.

"We are now the one who follows Sister Xue, so what about Ye Yan, so what about the monster list? Is it important to have Sister Xue?"

Hearing this, Xiao Luo was a little stunned.

He really wanted to say that Sister Xue is not here, and she can't hear you flattering her.

However, Qin Feng suddenly gave him a look and then looked at Ao Qing not far away.

Sister Xue is indeed not here, but Ao Qing is here.

Suddenly, Xiao Luo suddenly reacted.

"It makes sense!"

"Isn't it just a monster list? Sister Xue just wants to think about it, that's not just a casual one."

"Ha, let alone Sister Xue, even Brother Ao Qing doesn't have to take them seriously."

Hearing this, Ao Qing looked at the two of them.

"Is that person on the monster list very powerful?"

Hearing this, Qin Feng and the others shook their heads, "Not amazing."

Ao Qing frowned, "Go and call Ye Yan over, just say that Benlong wants to ask him for advice."

"ah?"

"What, go quickly!"

He Ao Qing was not targeting Ye Yan, nor was he targeting the evil list. He just wanted to say that everyone here, except for the little master, is all garbage.

The monster list, right? He really wants to see how powerful this so-called monster is.

When Qin Feng and the others heard this, they looked at each other with a hint of bitterness in their eyes.

If I had known this, I wouldn't have talked much.

However, the two of them were really curious about Ao Qing's strength.

Nine-clawed Dragon, they have never seen it before.

After a moment of silence, the two of them finally went.

"What, I want to ask my senior brother for advice?!"

Under Huoyun Peak, a Huoyun Peak disciple thought he had heard his ears, so he couldn't help asking again.

Qin Feng also said it again with a tough bullet.

"My elder brother wants to ask Senior Brother Ye for advice."

boom!

A very high temperature aura surged out from the body of the disciple Huoyun Peak in front of him, and he said a little hideously: "Your brother is so awesome. You dare to ask my senior brother for advice. If you ask him to come to me, see if you can pass by me." Let’s talk about it again!”

Hearing this, Qin Feng also had a bad expression.

"This brother, your senior brother is indeed very good, but my elder brother is not bad either."

"Do you know who my elder brother?"

Hearing this, the disciple of Huoyun Peak sneered, "Then tell me, who is your elder brother?"

Nowadays, Ye Yan is still in the academy, except for his mentors.

Unless the existence of the other monster list has also come back, no one else is qualified to ask his senior brother for advice.

"My elder brother, Ao Qing, Jiu Clawed Jilong, is this enough?"

Qin Feng said indifferently.

"Nine-clawed Dragon?!"

Hearing the Nine-Clawed Dragon, the Huoyun Peak disciple's face changed suddenly.

After a while, Ye Yan slowly descended from the Huoyun Peak.

"Nine-clawed Dragon?"

Ye Yan looked at Qin Feng and asked.

Hearing this, the two nodded, "Nine-clawed Dragon."

"lead the way."

Ye Yan did not say anything extra nonsense and followed Qin Feng and the others.

Jiuzhao Jilong, he has never fought with Jiuzhao Jilong in recent years. Of course, let alone fighting, he has never even seen him.

Just think that the nine-clawed dragon is a legend.

I never expected that this time I would be able to see it in the academy.

This was also a surprise.

Soon, Ye Yan came to the square.

Just one glance, Ye Yan saw Ao Qing who was silently following the martial arts list.

"I didn't expect that there was really a nine-clawed dragon in this world. It's worthy of being the golden world. It's really a mixture of fish and dragons."

Looking at Ao Qing, Ye Yan suddenly felt a little moved.

A strong fighting spirit also surged out of Ye Yan's body.

Hearing this, Ao Qing turned around slowly, and at the same time, a terrifying dragon power surged out of Ao Qing's body.

Suddenly, the void vibrated.

That is the dragon clan king, the pressure from the depths of his bloodline!
